</span></span></a></div></div></section><section id="comp-mskge690" tabindex="-1" data-block-level-container="Section" class="ke5pl1 comp-mskge690 wixui-section fwXYgt" data-testid="section-container"><div id="bgLayers_comp-mskge690" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-mskge690" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-mskge690" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-mskge690" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-testid="responsive-container-content" role="group" class="comp-mskge690-container max-width-container"><div id="comp-mslh114e" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mslh114e-container comp-mslh114e wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><div id="comp-mslh0xkj" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mslh0xkj-container comp-mslh0xkj wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><div id="comp-mslfnqp8" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mslfnqp8-container comp-mslfnqp8 wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><div id="comp-mslfnqpl" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mslfnqpl wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_6 wixui-rich-text__text">Before the rest of the world wakes up, Buen Hombre is already alive.</h2></div><div id="comp-mslfsfix" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mslfsfix wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The coffee machine &mdash; programmed the night before &mdash; fills the air with the deep, warm scent of fresh Dominican brew.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The first rays of light catch the lagoon and turn it gold. Your feet find the sand without thinking.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">One dog joins you on the walk, then another &mdash;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Shakira, Rocky, Pepe, Coco Chanel &mdash;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">padding beside you as you follow the shoreline.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The sea is a mirror.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The kites aren&#39;t up yet.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">This moment belongs only to you.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">This is Buen Hombre.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">And for a little while&hellip;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">it becomes yours.</p></div><div id="comp-mslfx83y" class="comp-mslfx83y wixui-vector-image"><div data-testid="svgRoot-comp-mslfx83y" class="iL7Pq5 gx51wo">
